headline: Conservation priorities for Acrobatic Dogs and Hadlock Field Family, and relocation of Glimpse by Wendy Klemperer.
summary: The meeting will cover conservation priorities for two artworks and a proposed relocation site for Glimpse. It will also cover encumbrances for the Bramhall Square Redesign and Congress Square Park – Phase 2.
items: Staff update on the public art fund
Encumbrances for new acquisitions of public art: Bramhall Square Redesign
Encumbrances for new acquisitions of public art: Congress Square Park – Phase 2
Announcement: Christina Ferragamo was appointed to the Portland Public Art Committee on October 5, 2026
Announcement: City Council voted on October 5, 2026 to deaccession the Jewel Box bus shelter
Discussion: Chair to invite Subcommittee members to add new business items to future monthly agendas
Announcement: Gabriel Frey artist commission at First Light Commons project update
Discussion: Evaluate public art guidelines section VI
Voting item: Evaluate cost estimates for Acrobatic Dogs and Hadlock Field Family as conservation priorities (public comment will be taken)
Voting item: Evaluate the proposed relocation site for Glimpse by Wendy Klemperer in the Jetport parking lot expansion project (public comment will be taken)
Announcement: Chair to invite Committee members to lead the Communication Subcommittee
Announcement: Prepare for FY27 Annual Report and future goal setting meeting

PORTLAND PUBLIC ART COMMITTEE 
Wednesday, October 21, 2026 
4:00 PM City Hall – Room 209, 389 Congress Street 
 
1. Zoom Meeting Information  
  
 
Allow your computer to install the free Zoom app to get the best meeting experience.  For 
more information on how to use Zoom, please go to: 
https://content.civicplus.com/api/assets/18148b5d-f26e-472f-8d2c-245db97e5c27 
Public comment will be taken; written comments may be submitted 
to publicart@portlandmaine.gov 
 
Join from PC, Mac, iPad, or Android: 
https://portlandmaine-gov.zoom.us/j/81634418875 
Phone one-tap: 
+19292056099,,81634418875# US (New York) 
+13017158592,,81634418875# US (Washington DC) 
Webinar ID: 816 3441 8875 
      
2. Call to Order  
3. Approval of the September 16, 2026 Meeting Minutes  
  
 
September 16, 2026 Meeting Minutes 
      
4. Staff Communication - No public comment will be taken  
  
 
A. Public art fund 
      
  
 
B. Encumbrances for new acquisitions of public art 
a. Bramhall Square Redesign 
b. Congress Square Park – Phase 2 
      
5. Governance Subcommittee - No public comment will be taken  
  
 
A. City Council Order 50-26/27 
Announcement item: Christina Ferragamo was appointed to the Portland Public Art Committee 
on October 5, 2026. 
      
  
 
B. City Council Order 54-26/27 
Announcement item: City Council voted on October 5, 2026 to deaccession the Jewel Box bus 
shelter. 
      
  
 
C. Public Art Committee agenda preparation 
Discussion item: Chair to invite Subcommittee members to incorporate new business items 
into future monthly agendas. 
      
6. Acquisitions Subcommittee - No public comment will be taken
A. Gabriel Frey artist commission at First Light Commons 
Announcement item: Subcommittee chair to provide project updates and introduce future 
Committee communications to document artwork commission. 
      
  
 
B. Public art guidelines 
Discussion item: Introduce a Committee discussion to evaluate the public art guidelines section 
VI. 
      
7. Collection Management Subcommittee  
  
 
A. Conservation priority projects - Public comment will be taken 
Voting item: The Committee to evaluate the cost estimates for Acrobatic Dogs and Hadlock 
Field Family as priorities for conservation. 
      
  
 
B. Relocation of public art - Glimpse by Wendy Klemperer - Public comment will be taken 
Voting item: The Committee to evaluate the proposed relocation site as included in the Jetport 
parking lot expansion project. 
      
8. Communication Subcommittee - No public comment will be taken  
  
 
Announcement item: Chair to invite Committee members to lead this Subcommittee. 
      
9. New Committee Business - No public comment  
  
 
Announcement item: The Committee to prepare for FY27 Annual Report and future goal 
setting meeting. 
      
10. Adjourn  
 
Next Meeting - November 18, 2026
